definition: A partnership return reporting the combined income, deductions, credits, and other tax items of a partnership, with each partner receiving a separate statement of their distributive share of partnership items.

includes.text: Form includes fields for partnership identification and income/loss reporting
Form reports ordinary business income and various categories of partnership income
Form includes detailed deduction sections for business expenses
Form allocates partnership items to individual partners

excludes.text: Reports self-employment business income of a sole proprietor, not allocations among multiple partners
Is the partner's individual statement, not the partnership return itself
Individual income tax return reports personal income and tax liability, not partnership items

discriminators.text: Allocates income among multiple partners through separate statements to each partner; the sibling reports business income of one self-employed individual
Partnership return is filed by the partnership entity itself and allocates to all partners; the sibling is a single partner's statement of their share
Partnership return reports combined partnership income and deductions allocated to partners; the sibling is an individual's personal income tax return
